brief:
APA Images is offering professional training to recent graduates in Gaza who hold journalism degrees but lack practical experience, the Electronic Intifada reported. The initiative aims to address a gap created as the ongoing conflict limits opportunities for young journalists to build portfolios and gain field experience in their profession.

The program represents an effort to sustain Gaza's media workforce as a generation of potential photojournalists faces barriers to employment and development during the territory's humanitarian crisis. Training focuses on equipping graduates with skills needed to document events and pursue careers in visual journalism.
dek: Genocide has left graduates with degrees but little experience. APA Images is bridging the gap.
title: APA Images trains Gaza photojournalists amid genocide aftermath
